privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Title: 1. Purpose of Collecting and Using Personal Information
privacy.section1Intro: Sodam AI Studio (the "Service") collects minimal personal information for the following purposes:
privacy.section1Item1: User identification and authentication for registration and service usage
privacy.section1Item2: Service provision, credit management, and payment processing
privacy.section1Item3: Service improvement and personalized content delivery
privacy.section2Intro: The following information is collected through Google OAuth:
privacy.section2RequiredItems: Email address, name, profile photo URL
privacy.section2AutoItems: Unique user ID, registration date, credit balance
privacy.section2UsageItems: Project data, generated images/videos, usage logs
privacy.section3Text: Personal information is destroyed without delay upon account deletion. However, data may be retained for periods required by applicable laws.
privacy.section4Text: We do not provide personal information to third parties in principle, except in the following cases:
privacy.section4Item1: When the user has given prior consent
privacy.section5Text: Personal data processing is delegated to the following partners for service operation:
privacy.section5Item2: Google LLC — OAuth authentication, AI image/video generation API
privacy.section6Text: Users may request access to, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing of their personal information at any time. Account deletion can be processed directly from the service settings page or by contacting the administrator.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.article1Text: These terms establish the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between the service provider and users regarding the use of Sodam AI Studio (the "Service").
terms.article2Item1: "Service" refers to the AI-based video storyboard production platform.
terms.article2Item2: "User" refers to any person who uses the Service under these terms.
terms.article2Item3: "Credits" refers to virtual currency used for AI features within the Service.
terms.article3Text: These terms take effect upon agreeing during registration and remain effective until account deletion. The service provider may modify these terms as needed, with changes taking effect through in-service notification.
terms.article4Item1: Registration is processed through Google OAuth.
terms.article4Item2: Users must provide accurate information and may not use another person's account without authorization.
terms.article4Item3: Users are responsible for managing their accounts.
terms.article5Text: The Service provides the following features:
terms.article5Item2: AI image matrix generation and editing
terms.article6Item1: AI features are used by consuming credits.
terms.article6Item2: Free credits are provided upon registration. Additional credits may be purchased.
terms.article6Item3: Used credits are non-refundable. However, credits lost due to service errors will be restored.
terms.article6Item4: Unused credits are valid for 1 year from purchase date.
terms.article7Item1: Copyright of content (images, videos, etc.) created through the Service belongs to the user.
terms.article7Item2: However, the service provider may use de-identified content for service improvement and promotion.
terms.article7Item3: Users must not create content that infringes on others' copyrights, portrait rights, etc.

welcome.title: Welcome to Sodam AI Studio!
welcome.desc: AI assists you through every step, from planning to final video. Let us show you around.

workflow.title: 4-Step Workflow
workflow.desc: Move through 1. Draft Planning → 2. Create Storyboard → 3. Refine Storyboard → 4. Produce Full Video. The Creative menu above also lets you generate images and videos on their own.

newProject.title: Create New Project
newProject.desc: Click here to start a new project. Choose your aspect ratio and scene count to begin.

projectGrid.title: Project Gallery
projectGrid.desc: Your projects appear here. Click any project to jump to where you left off.

credits.title: Credit Balance
credits.desc: Credits are consumed when using AI features. Monitor your balance and usage here.

ideaInput.title: Enter Your Idea
ideaInput.desc: Type your ad concept or brief. AI will generate scene-by-scene scripts.

generateBtn.title: Generate Script
generateBtn.desc: Launch the AI script engine. Scene compositions, narrations, and image prompts are generated automatically.

style.title: Visual Style Selection
style.desc: Choose from 10 visual styles for your scenes.

matrix.title: Image Matrix
matrix.desc: Generated cuts appear together on a single sheet. The grid shape changes with the number of cuts.

generate.title: Generate Images
generate.desc: Use Generate + Apply for the current unit, or Generate All for batch processing.

model.title: Pick an Image Model
model.desc: The model you pick changes how sharp the storyboard sheet looks. Start with the default, and switch if you need crisper cuts.

storyboard.title: Storyboard Preview
storyboard.desc: Generated scenes are arranged in an A4-format storyboard.

timeline.title: Timeline Manager
timeline.desc: Edit individual scenes, run AI story refinement, and upscale to high resolution.

export.title: Export Options
export.desc: Print your storyboard as PDF or download all images as ZIP.

modeSelect.title: Choose How to Produce
modeSelect.desc: Turn the whole storyboard into one video in a single pass, or build it scene by scene with fine control.

recommend.title: Which One to Pick
recommend.desc: Pick the left one if this is your first time or you want it done fast; pick the right one when a specific scene has to look right. You can also draft on the left, then redo only the weak scenes on the right.

replay.title: Onboarding Guide
replay.desc: Replay the guided tour for each page.
replay.replayAllDesc: Reset and replay all page tours from the beginning.

mode.title: Pick a Mode
mode.desc: Generate from text alone, guide it with reference images, or capture several angles at once.

model.title: Pick a Model
model.desc: Each model differs in sharpness and strengths. Start with the default, and switch if the result falls short.

generate.title: Generate
generate.desc: Results stay in your history. Save the ones you like to the Asset Library and reuse them in storyboards or videos.

frames.title: Start & End Frames
frames.desc: The start frame opens the video. Add an end frame and it will lead into that shot. You can pull either straight from the Asset Library.

resolution.title: Length & Resolution
resolution.desc: Choose the length and resolution. Setting an end frame requires the higher resolution, so it switches over automatically.

generate.title: Generate Video
generate.desc: Queue the next job while one is still running. Finished videos collect in the history on the right, ready to save.
